name: Lidar Scan
description: In a night parking garage a laser sweep turns the whole scene, and the subject, into a glowing point cloud.

wardrobe.man: a black bomber jacket, a white t-shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.woman: a black bomber jacket, a white t-shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.person: a black bomber jacket, a white t-shirt and black trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} walks toward the camera through an empty underground parking garage at night, mid-stride, wearing {wardrobe}. Rows of concrete pillars, painted floor lines, a few parked cars on both sides and long fluorescent tubes on the ceiling that fade into darkness. Medium-wide shot at eye level, symmetrical, the {subject} centered, full body visible. Cinematic night photography, cold fluorescent top light, green-tinted shadows. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain pillars and unbranded cars throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY walks toward the camera at a steady pace, eyes on a point just past the camera. A thin bright green laser line sweeps across the garage from left to right, and everything it passes, the pillars, the cars, the floor and the {subject}, turns into a glowing three-dimensional point cloud of millions of tiny dots floating in black space, holding the exact shapes and depth of the scene, until by the last second the whole garage is a luminous point cloud and the {subject} keeps walking as a figure made of glowing points. The camera dollies backward at walking pace. Sound: a rising electronic sweep, rapid clicking scan ticks, a low digital hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, a dense lidar point cloud with real depth, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. A thin bright green laser line sweeps across the frame from left to right, and everything it passes, including the {subject}, turns into a glowing three-dimensional point cloud of millions of tiny dots floating in black space, holding the exact shapes and depth of the scene, while the {subject} keeps moving as a figure made of glowing points. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a rising electronic sweep, rapid clicking scan ticks, a low digital hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, a dense lidar point cloud with real depth, sharp detail, stable picture.
